name: Roll Up Kids Toys Trading LLC
headline: ROLLUP KIDS TOYS
lede: Rollupkids is a renowned children's toy and corporate gift supplier in Dubai, UAE.
about: Rollupkids offer something for all ages, but the educational toy is very close to our hearts. Rollup Kids Toys are bound by our corporate social responsibility to care for children’s needs. Rollupkids will be a pioneer in the educational toys segment, and we have to donate a specific portion for underprivileged children’s welfare as part of our CSR.

Soft Gun for kids is a must-have item as it adds a lot of fun element in their life. But same time we are focused towards kids safety. Our soft guns are developed keeping kids safety in mind and are used only for fun category.
